messages.subject: combining replicates to call peaks
parts:
Hi, I would like to combine/pool two replicates before calling peaks.  It looks like the current functionality only allows for 1 replicate/input file at a time... if someone knows how this can be done, I would be really grateful.

Thank you very much!
Rajat

messages.author: f6e447b2fd794867
messages.subject: Re: combining replicates to call peaks
parts:
Hi Rajat,

Yes, currently mosaics package does allow only single file for each of ChIP and Input. Easy way to combine/pool replicates might be to use linux commands to use multiple text files such as 'cat' and use them as input files for mosaics package. Hope it helps.

Thanks,
Dongjun
